topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Hey, I heard about the fence, and honestly, I think it’s a great idea! We’ve always valued our little slice of privacy, and it just seems like an extension of that, you know? Plus, I can totally see the kids playing back there without a care in the world, safe and sound. If there’s anything we can do to help, just let us know. Maybe we could even have a little get-together once it’s up? Barbecue or something, just to celebrate. It’d be a fun way to kick back and enjoy the space together. What do you think?
